podcast-dannyjones-8fKiw4wfubM:
Eric Czuleger joins Danny Jones to talk about mind warfare: the contest to shape what populations believe, waged through media control and watched from orbit by space surveillance systems. His subject is the machinery of perception, who builds it, who runs it, and how a citizen can tell when it is pointed at them.

The conversation links propaganda techniques to the satellites and platforms that deliver them. Czuleger treats information operations as the main battlefield of modern conflict, with territory secondary. Jones pushes for examples a listener can check. The claims are the guest's analysis rather than declassified fact, but the framework, states fighting first over minds, is one intelligence professionals themselves use. Listeners get a tour of that doctrine and its discontents.
podcast-joerogan-5SeRJe5MMbM:
Duncan Trussell opens Joe Rogan Questions Everything, a spin-off series, with this audio-only first episode. Trussell, a comedian and frequent Rogan guest, helps set the show's tone: curious, loose, and glad to chase odd questions wherever they lead.

The two riff on the strange topics the series title promises, mixing jokes with real wonder about the world. Without cameras, the talk feels closer to a late-night phone call than a studio show. As a first entry, it shows the format before it settled, and it preserves the easy chemistry that made Trussell a fixture in Rogan's circle.
podcast-joerogan-zamjY2dgcbM:
Phony television psychics get exposed in this Joe Rogan Experience segment on the tricks of the trade. Rogan has long mocked performers who claim to speak with the dead for paying audiences. Here he and his guest pull apart how the act really works.

They explain cold reading, the art of fishing for details while seeming to know them already. Hot readings, where staff gather facts on guests before the show, also get covered. The pair argue the act preys on grief for profit. Skeptics will enjoy the takedown, and the amused get a look behind the curtain of a durable con.
podcast-tuckercarlson-eFWDyrnyhbM:
Former congressman Ron Paul joins Tucker Carlson for a talk on warnings that came true. The episode title says his next warning is a grim one. Paul spent years in Congress as a lone voice against war and debt.

Paul and Carlson walk through the calls Paul made on money, war, and state power that later proved right. Paul then gives his next call on where the country is headed. Carlson treats him as a prophet the town should have heard. Listeners get the old lion of the liberty right in his own words, at full length and in a warm mood.
